before.requirement: Allow cJSON_Minify to reduce a whole-input single-line comment to an empty string.
before.reason: Minify skips the comment, but parse_value rejects the comment-only input. The harness returns on that parse failure before invoking Minify.

after.requirement: Allow cJSON_Minify to reduce a whole-input single-line comment to an empty string.
after.reason: The Minify behavior remains supported, and the same parse-success gate still prevents the call.

claims.reason: The same Minify capability exists before and after, and the same old-harness parse gate blocks the same comment-only input on both sides.
